name: effect-gel-split
title: Gel Button Split
description: Một nút gel bị kéo căng hai bên, cổ chất lỏng ở giữa mảnh dần rồi đứt thành hai nút A và B nảy rung; sau đó hai nút hút lại nhập thành một.

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Two pills 60x44 start overlapped (centres ±22). 0.3-0.5 s squeeze to ±18 (power2.out, scaleX 0.94); 0.5-1.3 s pull apart to ±54 (power1.in), scaleX to 1.16, scaleY = 1 / √scaleX, neck width 22 × scaleY × (1 − (d − 22) / 32)^1.4, reaching 0 at 1.3 s (split). Then centres to ±74 on a spring k260 d12 with a scaleX wobble 1 + 0.16 × (1 − spring k300 d9). Rejoin at 3.0 s on a spring k200 d22 (scaleX bump 1.05), neck back after 0.18 s. Params: squeeze (±18 px) · pull (±54 px, 0.8 s) · split (1.3 s) · spring (k260 c12) · wobble (k300 c9) · rejoin (k200 c22). Squeeze to ±18 (power2.out), pull apart to ±54 (power1.in) with the neck 22 × scaleY × (1 − (d − 22) / 32)^1.4, split, then springs k260 c12 (centres) and k300 c9 (wobble); rejoin on k200 c22.
